theme: Mike's care today, Tokyo on the line tonight.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Today bends toward Mike — two appointments and surgery prep for tomorrow — with a late Zoom to Tokyo to close it out.

needsAttention.title: Mike's oral surgery is tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Surgery is Thursday in Portland. Tonight's list is prescriptions, soft food, and ice packs, and you're his ride home since he can't drive after sedation.

needsAttention.title: IMC research call tomorrow night
needsAttention.detail: You, Mike and Chie meet on Teams at 9 PM tomorrow on the next stage of the IMC research; a skim of the StePs thread beforehand will help.

flagged.title: NACD New England reception
flagged.detail: NACD New England asks you to RSVP for the Sept 15 appreciation reception.

flagged.title: New LinkedIn message from Peter
flagged.detail: A message is waiting for your reply on LinkedIn.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts, job alerts, and your own daily Japanese lessons.

recipe.title: The splendid summer tomato sandwich
recipe.why: Peak-season tomatoes are at their sweetest right now, so this is the moment for a sandwich that asks nothing more of them.

acts.line: Mike's 9:30 throat ultrasound on Foden Road opens the day.
A 3:30 brain MRI on Technology Way, then a 5 o'clock haircut.
An 8 o'clock Zoom with Jomon Associates in Tokyo closes things out.
